requirements.Title: HP's First Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop a printer featuring HP’s first business ink tank system, targeting SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP’s portfolio and responds to market shift towards CISS solutions for SMBs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, Supplies Quality, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: CISS technology integration, business ink tank design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is released with business ink tank system and validated as first in HP’s business lineup.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-driven productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan workflows.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP from competitors, meets SMB needs for efficiency and ROI.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available, tested, and deliver measurable productivity improvements.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Provide a portal for SMBs to manage printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed businesses.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT; portal simplifies device management and supports business growth.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available, user-tested, and supports printer management for SMB customers.

requirements.Title: Low Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO, with minimal intervention required.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value ROI and efficiency; low TCO is a key purchase driver.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Cost optimization, ink tank efficiency, maintenance design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is validated to be lowest among HP business printers through benchmarking.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance
requirements.Description: Ensure printer requires minimal maintenance, with fewer parts to replace over its lifecycle.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces operational burden for SMBs without IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance requirements are lower than competitors and HP predecessors (if any), validated through testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – High Recycled Content Percentage (RCP)
requirements.Description: Printer must contain at least 60% recycled content, outperforming competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and appeals to environmentally conscious SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is certified to contain 60% RCP and meets HP sustainability standards.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer warranty of 80k pages or 2 years (whichever is first). Enable customer replaceable parts (PHA), and service center replaceable parts (MINK) if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need reliability and quick service options due to lack of IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Service design, part accessibility, warranty policy
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published, customer replaceable parts are validated, service center support is operational.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mistakes and improves user experience for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are implemented and tested for error prevention and compatibility.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: Support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, enable PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of SMBs for advanced management and service models.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU supports SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View, and PaaS as specified.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: Improve speed to 25/20 min, support PDL/PS, meet Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: PDL SKU targets higher performance and compliance for SMBs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, Tech Reg, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Speed optimization, PDL/PS integration, Blue Angel compliance
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU meets speed targets, supports PDL/PS, and achieves Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry for printer usage, maintenance, and performance monitoring.
requirements.Rationale: Supports remote management, troubleshooting, and product improvement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features are implemented, functional, and data is accessible for analysis.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities through HP App integration.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexible printing options for modern workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is enabled, tested, and compatible with HP App.

requirements.Title: Solutions/Services Monetization
requirements.Description: Enhance and monetize solutions/services, especially those leveraging AI.
requirements.Rationale: Supports business growth and aligns with HP’s goals for PaaS acceleration.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions/services are enhanced and monetization strategy is implemented and tracked.

requirements.Title: Advanced Device Management Features
requirements.Description: Provide advanced device management features in the SMB portal, such as fleet management and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Empowers SMBs to manage multiple devices efficiently without IT expertise.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Fleet management and analytics features are available and user-tested in the portal.
